mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for October 1, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Jewish human rights barrister, 94, arrested for supporting Palestine Action. Margaret Owen OBE, a celebrated human rights lawyer and friend of Ed Miliband's late mother, talks to Al Jazeera. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 2. Palestinians to bury remains of 105 people killed in Israeli attack on Gaza. Coffins containing the remains of those killed will be carried in a funeral procession involving family members. This was reported by Al Jazeera. 3. New Google Maps images reveal massive scale of devastation in Gaza. Satellite imagery shows further destruction of homes, businesses and places of worship since fragile ceasefire. This was reported by The Guardian. For the full source-backed dispatch, read the October 1, 2026 Gaza edition at dispatches.thebluefernco.com.
